_comment: Oslo S (NSR, Bane NOR). Draft from OSM via Overpass (cached 2026-10-28), schema 2. OSM numbers Oslo S's floors the Norwegian way: level 1 is the ground floor with the platforms (untagged platforms and paths default there), level 2 the upper concourse (Østbanehallen gallery, bridge to the Oslo City side), level 0 and -1 below ground (Flytoget/metro passages). The train platforms are multipolygon relations in OSM (refs 1–19), so multipolygons is on. Names by number until Bane NOR's plan and the owner's video are read for the proper names.

Bane NOR's station page, track table (facts): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/banenor_platforms_NO.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OpenStreetMap (Overpass, 2026-10-28), schema 2. Levels named by number only; the video and Bane NOR's plan are still to be read.
Levels renumbered to OSM's Norwegian floors (1 = ground with the platforms); default_level 1; untagged paths within 60 m of platforms kept.

Platform heights from Bane NOR's station page, track table (facts); 84 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/NO-OSL_S).
